references.text: Zebul, the ruler of the city, became furious when he heard about Gaal's words and warned Abimelech of the rebellion that was about to break out.
The continuation of the conflict between Gaal and Abimelech, where Gaal was driven into flight and expelled from Shechem.
Background to the conflict: The men of Shechem began to rebel against Abimelech after three years of rule.
Gaal son of Ebed came to Shechem and gained the trust of the city's inhabitants, openly challenging Abimelech's authority.
A similar pattern of civil war in Israel, where the Israelites went out to fight against Benjamin.
